summary: The page mostly adheres to design tokens, but ds:Dialog exhibits a container confinement issue causing clipped backdrop and partially occluded background text in the sidebar.

issues.title: Confined dialog scrim clipping content
issues.description: The dialog overlay renders within a bounded sidebar container rather than portaling globally, cutting off underlying helper text.
issues.evidence: Dark overlay rectangle in the right column partially masks text, leaving orphan word 'completes.' exposed at bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Mount dialog via a portal to cover the entire viewport.
